sources.title: ECM technology
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 工業雷射焊接
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付電荷質量換算、效率回推與假設敏感度。；教學材料帳允差 ±5%，需明列 η 與 z 假設，幾何合格不得由總質量代替。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver charge–mass conversion, inferred efficiency and assumption sensitivity.; Teaching material balance tolerance is ±5% with explicit η and z; total mass cannot substitute for geometry.
related.difference: 用自由熱收縮量建立焊接變形的尺度概念，分清收縮與拘束應力。
related.differenceEn: Use free thermal contraction to establish distortion scale and distinguish shrinkage from restraint stress.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: m=ηMQ/(zF)，M 為摩爾質量、z 為電子數、F 為法拉第常數。；教學理想化鐵二價溶解 M=55.845 g/mol、Q=193 C、z=2、F=96485 C/mol、η=1。；m=55.845×193/(2×96485)=0.0558537 g。
自由收縮幅值 |ΔL|=αL|ΔT|；拘束會改變位移並產生應力。；教學 α=12×10⁻⁶/K、L=100 mm、冷卻溫差幅值 100 K。；|ΔL|=12×10⁻⁶×100×100=0.120 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: m=ηMQ/(zF), with molar mass M, electron number z and Faraday constant F.; Teaching idealized Fe(II) dissolution: M=55.845 g/mol, Q=193 C, z=2, F=96485 C/mol and η=1.; m=55.845×193/(2×96485)=0.0558537 g.
Free-contraction magnitude |ΔL|=αL|ΔT|; restraint changes displacement and creates stress.; Teaching α=12×10^-6/K, L=100 mm and cooling-difference magnitude 100 K.; |ΔL|=12×10^-6×100×100=0.120 mm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 金屬射出成形
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付電荷質量換算、效率回推與假設敏感度。；教學材料帳允差 ±5%，需明列 η 與 z 假設，幾何合格不得由總質量代替。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver charge–mass conversion, inferred efficiency and assumption sensitivity.; Teaching material balance tolerance is ±5% with explicit η and z; total mass cannot substitute for geometry.
related.difference: 把金屬質量分率與體積分率分清，從配料帳推算燒結成品的理想體積。
related.differenceEn: Separate metal mass fraction from volume fraction and infer ideal sintered volume from the feedstock ledger.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: m=ηMQ/(zF)，M 為摩爾質量、z 為電子數、F 為法拉第常數。；教學理想化鐵二價溶解 M=55.845 g/mol、Q=193 C、z=2、F=96485 C/mol、η=1。；m=55.845×193/(2×96485)=0.0558537 g。
各成分體積為質量除密度；混合物密度不能以質量分率線性平均材料密度。 合成 100 g 配料含金屬 90 g、黏結劑 10 g，密度分別 7.5 與 1.0 g/cm³，忽略混合空隙。 Vmetal=90/7.5=12 cm³，Vbinder=10 cm³；金屬體積分率 12/22=54.545%，混合密度 100/22=4.545 g/cm³。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: m=ηMQ/(zF), with molar mass M, electron number z and Faraday constant F.; Teaching idealized Fe(II) dissolution: M=55.845 g/mol, Q=193 C, z=2, F=96485 C/mol and η=1.; m=55.845×193/(2×96485)=0.0558537 g.

Component volume equals mass divided by density; mixture density is not a mass-weighted arithmetic mean of constituent densities. Synthetic 100 g feedstock contains 90 g metal and 10 g binder with densities 7.5 and 1.0 g/cm³; neglect mixing voids. Metal volume=12 cm³ and binder volume=10 cm³; metal volume fraction=12/22=54.545%, mixture density=100/22=4.545 g/cm³.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
